about:
**Email:** thanawan.tchs@gmail.com

I'm a **Full Stack Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience** building scalable web, mobile, and backend solutions for enterprise clients. My technical background includes **React, React Native, Vue.js, Node.js, Java/Spring Boot, Go, and automated testing.** I've led engineering teams, collaborated directly with international clients, and translated business requirements into practical and reliable technical solutions.

experience.summary: Delivered software solutions for leading enterprise clients, including **True Corporation**, **AIA Hong Kong**, and **The 1 by Central**, as a Full Stack Software Engineer at **Palo IT**, contributing to customer-facing web and mobile applications, backend services, test automation, and CI/CD pipelines.
resumeHighlights: Delivered web, mobile, and backend solutions for enterprise clients including The 1 Central, AIA Hong Kong, and True Corporation
Led a team of 6 engineers building a React Native insurance claims feature
Built secure customer data services with Node.js, DynamoDB, and AWS KMS

projects.name: The 1 Central
highlights: Built **The 1 CRM** customer management platform with **Vue.js**, providing customer service representatives with a centralized interface to manage customer profiles, purchase history, contact information, and loyalty point adjustments.
Built a secure **Profile Service** with **Node.js** and **DynamoDB**, protecting sensitive customer PII through AWS KMS encryption and decryption.
Built a **Case Management Service** to capture and audit all customer profile updates, improving traceability, compliance, and issue investigation.
Collaborated with Product owner to analyze requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business needs and system implementation.

projects.name: AIA Hong Kong
highlights: Developed the **insurance claim submission feature** for the AIA Hong Kong mobile application using **React Native**, enabling customers to submit insurance claims through a guided, user-friendly form.
Led a team of **6 engineers** in delivering the claim submission feature, coordinating development tasks, code reviews, and technical discussions to ensure timely delivery.

Designed and implemented **Backend-for-Frontend (BFF)** APIs using **Java Spring Boot** to support the claim submission workflow and streamline communication between the mobile application and backend services.
Developed and maintained end-to-end (E2E) automated tests using **Detox**, improving application quality and increasing confidence in production releases.
Implemented **CI/CD pipelines** to automate application builds and testing, enabling faster and more reliable delivery of new releases.
Worked on-site with the AIA Hong Kong team during two business trips, facilitating requirement, technical discussions, and feature delivery.

projects.name: True Corporation
highlights: Developed the **User Profile** feature for the **TrueID** mobile application using **Kotlin**, enabling users to view and manage their personal account information.
Developed and maintained end-to-end (E2E) automated tests using **Appium**.
Developed the **MyAccount** web application for **TrueID** using **React**, allowing users to manage their profile information through a responsive web interface.
Implemented end-to-end (E2E) automated tests using **Cypress** to ensure application quality and support reliable software releases.

resumeHighlights: Built core loan management microservices in Go for Kasikorn Bank and the Government Savings Bank
highlights: Developed core **loan management microservices** using **Go**, supporting the end-to-end loan lifecycle for financial institutions, including **Kasikorn Bank** and the **Government Savings Bank**.
Implemented interest and penalty calculation services to automate loan repayment processing in accordance with business rules.
Developed an accounting service to generate financial transaction journals, ensuring accurate and auditable accounting records.
Performed unit and integration testing to ensure the correctness and reliability of backend services.
Automated API testing and deployment workflows using **Postman** and **Jenkins**, improving testing efficiency and release quality.
